DICOM Study Data
==============

The DICOM Study Data module manages medical imaging studies associated with patient care.

Data Collection Fields
--------------------

Study Information
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Patient Link**: The patient whose imaging is being recorded
* **Study Instance UID**: Unique identifier for the imaging study
* **Study Date**: When imaging was performed
* **Study Description**: Type/purpose of imaging study

Series Information
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Series Descriptions**: Details of image series within study

Project Association
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Project Assignment**: CHAVI projects associated with these images

Special Considerations
--------------------

1. Data Management:

   #. Maintain unique identifiers  
   #. Link to relevant clinical events  
   #. Ensure proper study organization  

2. Documentation:

   #. Record complete study details  
   #. Note any technical issues  
   #. Track study relationships
